collegeInfo: S. P. Jain Institute of Management & Research (SPJIMR), established in 1981, is a top-tier management institute in Mumbai with 'Triple Crown' accreditation (AACSB, AMBA, EQUIS) and global recognition.

Guidelines circulated; award based on merit and need

nirfOverallRank: 20th in the Management Category by NIRF (2024)

events.eventFullDescription: OJAS is SPJIMR’s three-day annual cultural and management fest featuring performances in music, dance, quizzes, case-study challenges, and business events. It’s ranked as India’s 4th most popular B-school festival by Unstop.
SPJIMR’s annual sports fest, SPRINT, is among the biggest B-school sports extravaganzas in India, hosting a wide range of indoor and outdoor competitions.
Grey Matter is SPJIMR’s annual quiz, organized by the ADMAP Committee, engaging students, faculty, staff, and alumni in a test of general knowledge and strategy.
SPARC is the institute’s annual talk series where inspirational stories are shared by students, alumni, faculty, and notable personalities on leadership, innovation, and social impact.
SARGAM is SPJIMR’s annual musical and dance night featuring thematic performances curated by students.
